Class RangeAssert<C extends Comparable<? super C>>

java.lang.Object
org.assertj.core.api.AbstractAssert<RangeAssert<C>, Range<C>>
be.imgn.gaia.core.testing.RangeAssert<C>
Type Parameters:
C - the type of the values
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.assertj.core.api.Assert<RangeAssert<C>, Range<C>>, org.assertj.core.api.Descriptable<RangeAssert<C>>, org.assertj.core.api.ExtensionPoints<RangeAssert<C>, Range<C>>
public final class RangeAssert<C extends Comparable<? super C>> extends org.assertj.core.api.AbstractAssert<RangeAssert<C>, Range<C>>
AssertJ assertions on a Range. 
assertThat(Range.closedOpen(0, 10)).contains(0, 9).doesNotContain(10).encloses(Range.closed(2, 5));
Since:
0.1.2
